summary: This note is a clipped table of contents from the open college biology textbook "College Biology 1" hosted on the SLCC Pressbooks site, not a body of text on sexual reproduction itself. Its part XVIII, "Sexual Reproduction and Meiosis," lists sections on sexual reproduction, life cycles, meiosis and nondisjunction. The surrounding chapters cover topics from the definition of life through genetics and cellular respiration. The note is cut off partway through the cellular respiration chapter.
one_line: Table of contents of the open SLCC College Biology 1 textbook, including its sexual reproduction and meiosis chapter.
key_facts: The source is the online book "College Biology 1" hosted on the slcc.pressbooks.pub site, published by OPEN SLCC.
Part XVIII of the book is titled "Sexual Reproduction and Meiosis".
Section 18.1 of the book is titled "Sexual Reproduction".
Section 18.2 of the book is titled "Life Cycles of Sexually Reproducing Organisms".
Section 18.3 of the book is titled "Meiosis" and has the subsections Overview, Meiosis I, Meiosis II, and Comparing Meiosis and Mitosis.
Section 18.4 of the book is titled "Nondisjunction" and has the subsections Chromosome Number Abnormalities, Aneuploidy, and Sex Chromosome Nondisjunction in Humans.
Part XIX of the book is titled "Genetics 1" and includes sections on Foundations of Modern Genetics, Segregation, Punnett Squares and Laws of Probability, and Independent Assortment.
Section 19.1 of the book has a subsection titled "About Gregor Mendel".
Part III of the book is titled "Evolution 1" and includes section 3.1 "Darwin and Natural Selection", which has a subsection on "Charles Darwin".
Part XVI of the book is titled "Cell Division and the Cell Cycle" and includes section 16.3 "Mitosis and Cytokinesis".
Part XV of the book is titled "Evolution 2" and includes sections on Variation and Evolution, Causes of Mutation, and Types of Mutation.
Part XXIII of the book is titled "Cellular Respiration" and begins with section 23.1 "Overview of Cellular Respiration".
The note's contents list ends partway through the cellular respiration chapter, so it does not include the body text of the sexual reproduction chapter.
